name: Plex
description: Refreshes the Plex libraries when a package finishes.

codes.plex_notifier.setting.section.descriptio: The number of the Plex library the downloads go to (Plex Web shows it as source=<number> in the library's address). Only with it can Plex scan just the finished package's folder; left empty, every library is refreshed.
codes.plex_notifier.setting.path_mapping.descr: One line per folder: rDownloader's path=the path Plex sees, e.g. /downloads=/data/media. The longest matching path decides; a package outside every line refreshes the whole section.
